settings.hero_desc: We build parametric wall art that mesmerises your audience when they look at it. A striking, contemporary piece that brings depth and movement to homes, offices and receptions. Send us a comission inquiry and we will design a paramertic art for your space.

settings.s1_body: A parametric wave panel turns a flat wall into a sculpture. Precisely cut slats flow into a rippling, three-dimensional wave and are hand-finished in warm wood tones that shift with the light. Made to your size and pattern, it's a contemporary statement piece for living rooms, offices, receptions and hospitality spaces.
settings.case_body: Created as a feature wall piece, this parametric panel became the focal point of the room - a sculptural wave that visitors stop to look at and run their hand across.
settings.case_quote: It transformed the wall. Everyone who visits comments on it.
settings.prov_p: Great wall art changes a space. A parametric wave brings light, shadow and movement to a blank wall - a quiet centrepiece that never stops drawing the eye.
